#!/bin/sh
set -eu
for name in ji-stage6-performance-final2 ji-stage6-maven-consumer-final ji-stage6-maven-consumer-final-offline ji-stage6-release-smoke-relay ji-stage6-release-smoke-web ji-stage6-release-smoke-ingress; do
  docker rm -f "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
done
for directory in "$HOME/ji-stage6-performance-final2" "$HOME/ji-stage6-package-smoke" "$HOME/ji-stage6-failed-health" "$HOME/ji-stage6-maven-final"; do
  if test -d "$directory"; then
    docker run --rm -v "$directory:/ji-cleanup" alpine:3.22 sh -eu -c 'rm -rf /ji-cleanup/* /ji-cleanup/.[!.]* /ji-cleanup/..?*'
    rmdir "$directory"
  fi
done
rm -f "$HOME/ji-stage6-performance-final2.tar.gz" "$HOME/ji-stage6-maven-final-input.tar.gz"
printf '%s\n' STAGE6_JI_OWNED_CLEANUP_OK
docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' | while IFS= read -r name; do
  case "$name" in ji-stage6-*) printf 'REMAINING_CONTAINER=%s\n' "$name";; esac
done
